output_list.reason: The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow attack vulnerability. When the balance of 'msg.sender' is very large, subtracting _value from it will cause an underflow and result in balanceOf[msg.sender] becoming a large positive number, allowing attackers to make arbitrary users gain more tokens.

The 'distributeTokens' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'startIndex' and 'endIndex' are large, 'i' in the for-loop will exceed the maximum uint256 value, causing 'i' to overflow and become a very large positive number, allowing attackers to Make arbitrary users gain more tokens.
